title: The 4 Best Yoga Mats for Hot Yoga
h1: The 4 Best Yoga Mats for Hot Yoga
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for yoga mats for hot yoga, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at yoga mats for hot yoga using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Manduka PRO Yoga Mat 71-Inch 6mm
products.blurb: Key specs: 6mm closed-cell PVC construction, Closed-cell surface resists moisture absorption, Lifetime guarantee against wear.
strengths: Closed-cell surface sheds sweat instead of soaking it in, so it never gets waterlogged
Dense 6mm cushioning stays stable under standing poses even as the mat warms up
Lifetime guarantee reflects genuine long-term durability under daily studio use
limitations: Needs a short break-in period, texture feels slightly slick for the first several sessions
26 lbs is heavy for carrying to and from a studio without a strap

products.name: prAna E.C.O. Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: Closed-cell natural rubber base, Two-sided texturing for grip, Non-toxic, PVC-free construction.
strengths: Two-sided texture gives usable grip even once the surface gets damp
Closed-cell natural rubber wipes clean quickly after a sweaty class
PVC-free construction appeals to practitioners avoiding synthetic materials
limitations: Natural rubber has a noticeable smell out of the box that fades over a week or two
Fewer ratings than the market leaders, so long-term durability data is thinner

products.name: BalanceFrom GoYoga All-Purpose Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/4-inch (6mm) high-density foam, Double-sided non-slip texture, Includes carrying strap.
strengths: Double-sided texture gives basic grip for early hot yoga sessions before you commit to a premium mat
limitations: Foam construction absorbs sweat over time and needs more frequent airing out
Loses grip faster than closed-cell rubber once heavily saturated
Less durable long-term than the Manduka PRO under daily hot yoga use

products.name: Gaiam Essentials Thick Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 10mm (2/5-inch) NBR foam cushioning, Textured non-slip surface, Easy-cinch carrying strap.
strengths: 10mm cushioning is comfortable for practitioners who mix hot yoga with general floor work
Textured surface provides adequate grip for lower-intensity or shorter hot sessions
limitations: Extra thickness can feel less stable during standing balance poses once the mat warms and softens
Foam surface is more prone to sweat absorption than rubber options
Not the first choice for daily or intense Bikram-style practice

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
